name: Western Mining Co.,Ltd.
summary: Western Mining Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the mining, beneficiation, smelting, and trading of metals in Mainland China and internationally. It operates through Nonferrous Metal Mining, Beneficiation and Smelting; Metal Trading; and Financial Service segments.
